name: Amplemarket
tagline: Give your Grok Bot a full sales stack - prospect data, signals, and outreach.
install_steps: Create an Amplemarket account at amplemarket.com - it's the AI sales platform behind Duo: prospect search, buying-intent signals, data enrichment, and multichannel sequences.
In your Grok Bot's connector / plugin settings, add the Amplemarket connector and sign in with your Amplemarket account.
Paste the prompt below so prospect research, enrichment and outreach prep become a standing capability you drive in plain language.
prompt: You are setting up an Amplemarket integration inside Grok Bot. Connect the Amplemarket connector with my account, then read what it exposes so you understand it: an AI sales platform with a prospect database (Searcher), buying-intent and job-change signals, competitive intelligence, contact and company enrichment, and multichannel sequences (email, call, social). Then let me drive it in plain language: 'find me 20 VPs of sales at fintech companies in Europe', 'enrich this person and their company', 'who changed jobs at my target accounts this month', 'draft a 3-step sequence for this list'. Rules: outreach reaches real people, so ALWAYS show me the exact recipients and the full message or sequence and get my explicit approval before anything is sent or enrolled - drafts only until I say send; never invent a contact, email address, title, or company fact that Amplemarket didn't return - if a field is missing, say so; and respect suppression/do-not-contact lists. Confirm the connection by running one enrichment on a person or company I name.
description:
## What it does

Amplemarket is "Step into the future of sales: Human + AI" - an all-in-one AI sales platform built around **Duo**, its AI sales agent. It covers the whole pipeline: a prospect database with powerful filters (Searcher), buying-intent signals (website visits, job changes, competitor mentions, social engagement), data enrichment, competitive intelligence, multichannel sequences with AI-personalized copy (Duo Copywriter and Duo Voice), a unified inbox, and deliverability tooling (domain health, email warmup, spam checking). Its Grok Bot connector puts that stack in your Bot's hands.

## Use it in Grok Bot

Add the Amplemarket connector in your Bot's settings and paste the prompt on this page. From then on you prospect in plain language - "find 20 VPs of sales at European fintechs", "enrich this person", "who changed jobs at my target accounts" - and your Bot researches, enriches and drafts sequences from real Amplemarket data. Because outreach reaches real people, the prompt keeps the Bot on drafts-only: it shows you exact recipients and messages and waits for your approval before anything sends or enrolls. Pairs naturally with X prospecting - see the "find customers complaining about competitors" use case.
